# Distribution of world population by continent, 2020

- Post author By DSH Studies 
- Post date 30 November 2020 
- No Comments on Distribution of world population by continent, 2020 

Asia: 59.5% Africa: 17.2% 

Europe: 9.6% Latin America: 8.3% North America: 4.7%

1- China is 18% of the world population

2- India 17.5% of the world population

3- The United States of America 4.23% of the world population

4- Indonesia is 3.39% of the world’s population

5- Pakistan 2.83% of the world population

6- Brazil 2.71% of the world population

7- Bangladesh 2.17% of the world’s population

8- Nigeria 2.41% of the world population

9- Russia 1.88% of the world population

10 – Mexico, 1.62% of the world’s population
